password.algorithm: Argon2id via maintained password hashing library

accessToken.secretHandling: Private signing keys only in server secret configuration; fail startup outside test if absent; no embedded development fallback

refreshToken.format: opaque random token, at least 256 bits entropy
refreshToken.rotation: One-time compare-and-swap under transaction; consumed token retained as hash until family expiry
refreshToken.replay: Consumed-token reuse revokes family including newly rotated token; mobile uses single-flight refresh; no silent grace window

session.activeStateChecked: Every protected HTTP command/query and WS command must validate active user/session; signature alone is insufficient
session.revoke: Owner can revoke own session; outsider gets404; logout revokes current session; family invalidation closes/rejects protected socket commands
session.mutableRoles: Read roles/assignments from server state, not client role fields

challenge.hash: HMAC with server-held pepper, not a plaintext code or bare weak hash
challenge.rateLimit: Per recipient hash + IP/device; config required; accepted response does not reveal existence

recovery: Reset token is purpose-bound, short-lived, hash-stored and consumed atomically; password reset revokes all session families
registration: Contract packet specifies pending_email_verification flow and terms version; no active session before email proof; this is the recorded security default, not a Supabase Auth flow
parameters: These are explicit technical configuration defaults for the plan, not measured service guarantees. Changing policy requires versioned ADR, contract/fixture updates and regression tests.
